identity.name: Lecithin (non-fractionated)
identity.chemical_class: Complex mixture of phospholipids (mainly phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine, phosphatidylinositol)

function.mechanism: Amphiphilic phospholipids align at oil-water interfaces and reduce interfacial tension, stabilizing dispersions/emulsions.
common_food_categories: fat-based spreads and similar emulsified foods

adi.basis: EFSA ANS Panel (2017) concluded there is no need for a numerical ADI for lecithins (E 322).

efsa.key_finding: No safety concern at refined exposure estimates for the assessed populations and uses, including infants from 12 weeks.

adi.basis: WHO JECFA database lists lecithin ADI as NOT LIMITED.

concerns.summary: Recent in vitro and mouse studies reported gut microbiota composition shifts and intestinal barrier/morphology changes with lecithin exposure, although severity varied and some effects were less pronounced than with CMC.
Hypersensitivity risk is linked to residual soy/egg proteins in lecithin preparations; most non-IgE soy-allergic children tolerated soya lecithin in one crossover trial, with rare reactions.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA re-evaluation found no need for a numerical ADI and no safety concern at refined exposure estimates.
JECFA lists lecithin ADI as NOT LIMITED.

A randomized crossover human trial using a soy-lecithin comparator beverage reported no adverse endotoxemia/gut-barrier/cardiometabolic biomarker signal attributable to comparator exposure in study context.

adi_exceedance.notes: Numerical ADI not established (EFSA no numerical ADI; JECFA NOT LIMITED). EFSA nevertheless reported highest refined P95 exposures in children/toddlers under brand-loyal scenarios without concluding safety concern.

risk_assessment.rationale: Regulatory consensus is permissive (EFSA no numerical ADI, JECFA not limited, US GRAS) with no IARC listing or major-jurisdiction bans. Emerging gut-microbiome and allergenicity edge-case signals justify ongoing caution but do not currently outweigh the core regulatory safety conclusions for authorized uses.
key_factors: EFSA 2017: no numerical ADI and no safety concern at refined exposure
FDA/eCFR status in Part 184 GRAS framework with GMP-based use limitation
No lecithin entry in IARC classifications dataset
Recent in vitro/animal microbiome findings and residual-protein allergenicity considerations
